rationale: The stock gapped up ~8.9% on an earnings beat but is now showing clear intraday deterioration — the last 5 candles form a consistent sequence of lower highs and lower lows, dropping from ~$207 to $204.38, with price trading below both the 9-EMA ($205.20) and session VWAP ($204.51), suggesting the gap-up momentum has faded. A short thesis is tempting given the downward drift and negative news framing, but the stock remains well above the gap open ($199.19) with 314 minutes left and high relative volume (4.59x), making a mean-reversion bounce equally plausible; the risk/reward is unclear in either direction at this mid-range position (71.9% of day's range).
